capabilities: Display the current Spotify or Apple Music track in the status bar
Show an interactive popover with album art, progress bar, and play/pause/next/previous controls
Choose between Spotify and Apple Music in settings
Customize the status bar icon, display format, position, and maximum title length
Hide the status bar item when music is paused
extras: macOS only (uses native AppleScript). Album art is Spotify-only. Not yet in the community plugin browser; manual installation is via GitHub releases.
intentEvidence: Uses native macOS AppleScript. No Spotify Developer API keys, OAuth logins, or internet connections required.
motivation: The README says it works "without needing complex API keys or developer accounts," implying it was built to avoid that setup.
problem: Seeing what is playing normally requires opening the music app or setting up Spotify API keys and developer accounts.
summary: macOS-only plugin that shows the currently playing Spotify or Apple Music track in the status bar with a popover for progress and media controls.
